explanation.en: 'I stopped smoking' ends the habit; 'I stopped to smoke' interrupts something else in order to smoke. 'Remember posting it' is a memory of the act; 'remember to post it' is a duty ahead. 'Try doing' experiments; 'try to do' attempts with difficulty.

grammar.label: verb + object + -ing vs to-infinitive
grammar.form: see / hear / watch + object + -ing or base verb; want / expect / allow + object + to-infinitive
grammar.meaning: the -ing form shows an action in progress; the base form shows the whole event

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: The parent says she remembers posting the form.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Remembers posting it, or remembers that she had to post it?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It is the whole question. 'Remember posting' is a memory of the act. 'Remember to post' is a duty.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: She said 'I remember posting it on the Tuesday'.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Then she is describing a memory, and we should look for the form.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: The office says they stopped accepting late forms in April.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Stopped accepting them, or stopped to check each one?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I am not. I have watched a case turn on exactly that.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: One more. A neighbour says she saw the driver collect it.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Saw him collect it, then — the whole action. Write it down in her words, not yours.
